<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; background-color: white; border-collapse: collapse">
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="width: 1in; font-size: 10pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; color: #212529"><b>ITEM 1.01.</b></span></td>
    <td style="font-size: 10pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; color: #212529"><b>ENTRY INTO A MATERIAL DEFINITIVE AGREEMENT.</b></span></td></tr>
  </table>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">On
January 28, 2026, Ryman Hospitality Properties, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), entered into an Amendment No. 1 to Credit Agreement
(the &#8220;Amendment&#8221;) which amends that certain Credit Agreement dated as of May 18, 2023 (the &#8220;Credit Agreement&#8221;)
among the Company, as a guarantor, its subsidiary RHP Hotel Properties, LP (the &#8220;Borrower&#8221;), as borrower, certain other subsidiaries
of the Company party thereto, as guarantors, certain subsidiaries of the Company party thereto, as pledgors, the lenders party thereto
and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as administrative agent.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">The
Credit Agreement was amended to, among other things, (i) increase the Revolving Loan (as defined in the Credit Agreement) to $850,000,000.00,
(ii) remove the SOFR Adjustment (as defined in the Credit Agreement), and (iii) modify certain financial covenants applicable solely to
the Revolving Credit Facility (as defined in the Credit Agreement).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">As
modified by the Amendment, the material financial covenants, ratios or tests applicable to the Revolving Credit Facility are as follows:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&#183;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify">Consolidated net leverage ratio of not greater than 7.25x.</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&#183;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify">Consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio of not less than 1.50x.</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&#183;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify">Consolidated secured indebtedness must not be greater than 45%
of consolidated total asset value.</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&#183;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify">Consolidated secured recourse indebtedness must not be greater
than 10% of consolidated total asset value.</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&#183;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify">Unencumbered leverage ratio must not be greater than 60% (with
the ability to surge to 65% in connection with a material acquisition).</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<td style="width: 0.25in"/><td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&#183;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify">Unencumbered adjusted net operating income (NOI) to unsecured
interest expense ratio of not less than 2.0x.</td>
</tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white"><span style="background-color: white">In
addition, the Amendment extended the initial maturity date of the Revolving Credit Facility to January 2030, with the option to extend
the maturity date for a maximum of one additional year through either (i) a single 12-month extension option or (ii) two individual 6-month
extensions. </span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">Certain
lenders under the Credit Agreement or their affiliates have provided, and may in the future provide, certain commercial banking, financial
advisory, and investment banking services in the ordinary course of business of the Company, its subsidiaries and certain of its affiliates,
for which they receive customary fees and commissions.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">The
foregoing description of the Amendment does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text
of the Amendment, which is attached hereto as&#160;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Exhibit 10.1</span>&#160;and is incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; background-color: white; border-collapse: collapse"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 1in"><b>ITEM 2.03.</b></td><td style="text-align: justify"><b>CREATION OF A DIRECT FINANCIAL OBLIGATION OR AN OBLIGATION UNDER AN OFF-BALANCE SHEET ARRANGEMENT OF
A REGISTRANT.</b></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in; background-color: white">The information included
above in Item 1.01 is incorporated by reference into this Item 2.03.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 22.5pt">&#160;</p>

is incorporated herein by reference.</p>
